verdict.rationale: Open WebUI documents its own plugin system: Functions are modular Python plugins, alongside Tools, Pipes, Filters and skills. Its site advertises a community sharing loop ('Share what you build, run what others share'), so a community ecosystem exists as a product capability. Nothing in the pack shows its scale or vitality. Missing for 10: evidence of thousands of published plugins, skills or presets, evidence of active maintainers or ongoing curation, and independent community corroboration of a thriving marketplace.

support.subject: As a power user, the community ecosystem is genuinely alive — thousands of published skills, plugins, or presets with active maintainers

citations.quote: Extend with Python. Share what you build, run what others share.
Functions are modular Python plugins that extend the capabilities of Open WebUI itself.
Tools, Functions, Pipes, Filters, and Pipelines execute arbitrary Python code on your server.
